facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_正财 (Metal carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Fire. structural_interaction seed: "Fire directing Metal cross-polarity — focused warmth shaping the edge with discipline".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Steward: an edge in service of what it keeps. You maintain value with a craftsman’s discipline, tools oiled, accounts true, promises weighed before signing. Nothing gaudy, everything durable. What passes through your hands leaves better organized, and what stays becomes quietly excellent."
- k2_functional: "You execute with clean precision: zero waste, nothing reworked, every screw accounted for."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Thorough","Trustworthy","Slow and steady"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is machined: earned exactly, kept polished, compounded without drama. You are never flashy about money, and you hate not knowing where it went. Buy the thing that still earns its place a year on, and treat your own skills the same way.","Savings":"You save like an armorer: reserves as protection, kept bright and counted. The vault serves the life, so define what it defends, and spend without guilt inside those lines.","Steady love":"You love in maintained condition: reliability, kept promises, care with no rust on it. Choose someone who values upkeep, then schedule delight as faithfully as inspections."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 金_偏财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Quick-eyed","Polished","Adventurous"],"friction":["Mercenary","Deal-hungry","Restless"]}
- Sibling cell 金_偏财 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Every relationship carries a price tag only you can see. The friendship with useful contacts, the favor with its invoice pre-drafted, the warmth calibrated to net worth: your attention follows value with an honesty that would be refreshing if anyone enjoyed being an asset."

Core element Fire, energy element Metal. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Metal is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core that shows Metal on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Metal as the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 火_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
